items.label: Sleek & Sophisticated Design in Acacia Wood
items.value: Elevate your outdoor living space with this modern swivel patio chair, expertly crafted from FSC-Certified acacia wood and adorned with boho braid woven rope. Its sleek, sophisticated design seamlessly blends modern aesthetics with durable materials, making it a perfect addition to balconies, porches, gardens, or apartments. The wicker-inspired rattan look adds a touch of timeless elegance to your backyard or patio furniture collection.

items.label: 360-Degree Swivel
items.value: Experience the ultimate in outdoor relaxation with the chair’s smooth swivel mechanism, offering 360-degree rotation. Whether you're soaking up the sun, enjoying a conversation, or simply changing your view, this outdoor seating feature enhances your comfort and versatility. Perfect for porch, balcony, or garden settings, the swivel design ensures you never miss a moment of your outside oasis.

items.label: Weather-Resistant & Durable Construction
items.value: Built to withstand the elements, this chair features a sturdy acacia wood frame wrapped in handwoven polypropylene rope, ensuring both durability and style. The weather-resistant materials are designed to endure harsh conditions, while the acacia wood develops a richer, warmer hue over time. Ideal for outdoor patio furniture, this piece combines rattan-inspired woven rope with modern olefin fabric for a look that’s both chic and long-lasting.

items.label: Plush, Reversible Cushions for Maximum Comfort
items.value: Relax in luxury with the chair’s extra-thick, reversible cushions. The 7.9-inch seat cushion provides exceptional comfort, while the loose, reversible design offers versatility. Initially firm, the cushions will soften with use, ensuring long-lasting comfort. Two arm pillows are included, making this outdoor seating perfect for lounging in your garden, balcony, or backyard.

items.label: Easy Maintenance & Cleaning
items.value: Keep your outdoor patio furniture looking pristine with minimal effort. The water-resistant olefin fabric cushion covers and polypropylene rope are easy to clean—simply spot-clean with warm water and mild soap. For a deeper refresh, machine-wash the cushion covers on a cold cycle and air dry. In severe weather, store the cushions under covered areas to maintain their beauty.
